correctness.rationale: For each labeled ring x, adjacent equal spins form invariant seeds and an alternating gap erodes from both ends, so T_n(x)≤t iff no alternating window of length 2t+3 remains, except the two even-ring checkerboards already periodic at t=0. Edge differences have even global XOR parity and are 2-to-1 from x. The signed automaton on 2t+2 run-length states counts precisely valid parity-zero circular difference words, giving the stated two traces plus two checkerboards. Pattern-start factorial moments have hard-core overlap and asymptotically disjoint support; n*2^-(2t+3)→lambda implies Poisson(lambda) and e^-lambda entry probability. This reasoning agrees exactly with a complete published earlier proof. Finite tests in the inspected checker are corroborative only.
